text:
Ana: Noticed a funky pair of invoices for NimbusOps (acct NO-311) in the March run. Two invoices created for the same window; one includes the reserved_capacity line (+$4,800) and the other does not. Total mismatch ~ $4.8k.
Derek: Can you drop the invoice IDs? I'll check render/send history.
Ana: INV-2024-03-1102 (full, $28,450.00) and INV-2024-03-1102-RERUN (no reserved_capacity, $23,650.00). The RERUN was emailed to the billing contact yesterday.
Jules: Oof — customer might see different numbers. Any payments?
Ken: Payments: gateway shows a single payment for 28,450 (INV-2024-03-1102). So they were charged correctly but they received the lower PDF.
BillingBot: [alert] invoice-renderer: email-sent INV-2024-03-1102-RERUN to billing@nimbusops.com (job: ir-4392)
Derek: That suggests the render step used the retry draft instead of canonical invoice. Checking renderer logs now. Snippet: 
```
2024-03-15T22:04:02Z INFO invoice_renderer start job ir-4392
2024-03-15T22:04:03Z INFO fetch_invoice INV-2024-03-1102-RERUN status: draft
2024-03-15T22:04:04Z INFO render_pdf using invoice id: INV-2024-03-1102-RERUN
```
Derek: The generator had a rerun pathway that builds a new draft when transforms return non-fatal warnings. The renderer should prefer the canonical paid invoice if present.
Jules: For remediation: 1) send corrected invoice PDF to customer with note, 2) flag the RERUN invoice as "do not send" and void once confirmed, 3) add guard to renderer to prefer paid/canonical invoices.
Ana: Filed ticket FIN-6120 to track remediation and outgoing message. I've added "must send corrected PDF" to the ticket.
Ken: Can we confirm whether any collections emails went out using the wrong PDF? That would be bad.
Derek: Checked collections queue — none for NO-311. Only the statement email went to billing contact.
BillingBot: [info] FIN-6120 created by Ana assigned to Jules. SLA: 2 business days.
Jules: Quick root cause theory: transform v1 returned a warning "missing_reserved_capacity_tag" for NO-311 because the ingestion job that flags reservation tags ran later than usage aggregation. The rerun path created a fresh draft without the reserved line. Fix options: 1) ensure transforms wait for reservation-tagging job, 2) mark renderer to prefer canonical invoice id when payment exists. I'd do both (2 quick, 1 longer).
Ana: Please attach logs and the two PDFs to FIN-6120. Also add the customer-facing note draft: "We emailed an earlier draft that omitted your reserved capacity line. You were charged correctly; we apologize for the confusion. Sending corrected invoice now."
Derek: I pushed a small safeguard: renderer now checks invoice.status and invoice.linked_payments before picking draft. PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/invoice-renderer/pulls/1891
Jules: Reviewing the PR now. If tests pass let's deploy to staging and replay ir-4392.
Ken: Also run a query for other invoices with suffix "-RERUN" emailed between 2024-03-10 and 2024-03-16. If any other customers got a wrong PDF we need to batch notify.
Derek: ES index invoices-prod-2024-03. Ran query, found 12 reruns, 3 had been emailed. I'll upload CSV to FIN-6120.
Ana: Notifying support to prep a small customer outreach for the 3 affected accounts. Draft provided in ticket.
Jules: After hotfix to renderer, schedule a cleanup: revoke emailed drafts (if unpaid) and re-render the canonical invoices to recipients.
BillingBot: [info] FIN-6120 updated: logs + PDFs attached by Ana.
Ana: Thanks team. Will close FIN-6120 after outreach and cleanup.
Derek: Follow-up note: add telemetry to invoice-generator to mark drafts created from reruns so we can easily filter them in future scans.
Jules: Good call. Adding a task to FIN-6120 for a telemetry flag.
Ana: Closing loop here once outreach sent. :thumbsup:
